events.name: Bash
events.head: Check for a debuggable browser and find receiver URL
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ps aux | grep -i -E "remote-debugging|chrome.*Browser 2" | grep -v grep | head -3 | cut -c1-200; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "chrome|brave" | head; grep -n "script.google.com/macros" app/src/lib/form-log.ts | head -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: Probe live receiver health and check browser processes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; curl -sL "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbxgZiV7RLX8t5cE8fR8TN8a2tMe_0ufQnMsc5OpCJJU6CsVns__QS7qNWhoESTHiiKAnw/exec?health=1&v=$(date +%s)" | head -c 600; echo; ls scripts/probe-live-forms-to-sheet.mjs 2>&1; pgrep -lf "Google Chrome|Brave" | head -3 | cut -c1-120

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect receiver GET response and doGet handler
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; U="https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbxgZiV7RLX8t5cE8fR8TN8a2tMe_0ufQnMsc5OpCJJU6CsVns__QS7qNWhoESTHiiKAnw/exec"; curl -sL "$U?v=$(date +%s)" | grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" ; curl -sL "$U?v=$(date +%s)" | head -c 300; echo; git ls-files | grep -i "probe-live-forms\|Code.gs" | head; grep -n "doGet" -A12 $(git ls-files | grep -i "Code.gs" | head -1) | head -20
